text:
emma: ap-southeast1: spike in Pending tiny-gpu jobs (~95) at 05:30 UTC. Scheduler shows mix of InsufficientGPU and NodeAffinityMismatch.
noah: any recent label/taint changes?
emma: we flipped label keys yesterday from gpu.pool->gpu.class for a pilot rack and added taint redwood/maintenance=soon:NoSchedule on a subset.
li: sample describe: 
```
Events:
  Warning FailedScheduling 5m (x9 over 10m) default-scheduler 0/10 nodes are available: 4 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 6 node(s) didn't match Pod's nodeAffinity.
```
noah: sounds like label key rename caused affinity misses and taint blocked others.
emma: CI kicked off 60 parallel tiny jobs at 05:28 (ci-bot). Combined with aggressive scale-down we lost shared nodes.
li: quick fixes: mass-patch pending pods with toleration for redwood/maintenance, and temporarily add old label key back to nodes as fallback.
noah: I'll add the old label as a short-lived alias on nodes in the pilot rack. ops-bot: "Started node label reconciliation on 6 nodes"
emma: I'll mass-patch pending pods: kubectl get pods -nprod -o name | grep tiny | xargs -n1 kubectl patch --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/tolerations/-","value":{"key":"redwood/maintenance","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule"}}]'
(20s) emma: patched 82 pods, ~54 moved to Scheduling -> Running.
li: schedule descheduler to coalesce fractional pods after traffic subsides.
noah: create INC ticket and note runbook action: convert label rollout to include alias step and throttle CI bursts during label flights. ops-bot: "Incident #INC-9924 opened"
sre-bot: Alert[FRAG-APSE1]: tiny-pod pending > 50 for 12m
emma: cost note: leaving alias labels for 12h increases binpacking variance but avoids retry churn. We'll revert after pilot stabilized.
li: agree. postmortem + runbook updates after 24h. :thumbsup:
